preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 150,000.
Each tree must have at least 2 vertices and at most 300,000 vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum size of a good subtree for each query.
